sectionTitle: Personal Experience and Competing Proof Burdens

lockedMove.speaker: Victor Stenger
lockedMove.excerpt: um I don't not have to deny also that many people have what they sincerely believe is is an inner experience of God all I have to do is argue that this in inner experience can all be in their heads uh the way to prove that the inner experience is legitimate and not just something in their heads would be again for someone to come back with some knowledge that they could not possibly have known no one has ever done that just like my argument against Revelation uh and I think those arguments that I made early in the uh in the talk have not been rebutted
lockedMove.proposition: Inner experiences need independently unavailable information to distinguish external revelation from events wholly within a person’s mind.
